_comment: Synthetic BOIN dose-escalation trial: 3 dose cohorts of 10 patients each. Observed DLT rates are 0.10, 0.22, 0.40. With target_dlt_rate phi=0.25 the BOIN rule selects dose 2 (0.22 <= 0.25 < 0.40) as MTD. boin_dlt_boundary gate computes ratio = mtd_observed_dlt_rate / target_dlt_rate. To exercise BO-3 (advisory-only halt), the harness should pass mtd_observed_dlt_rate=0.32 (ratio=1.28 > 1.0, FAIL/halt) while keeping the test deterministic. Liu & Yuan 2015 (J R Stat Soc C 64(3):507-523).

halt_scenario._comment: Override used in BO-3: force MTD into a halt state without changing fixture trial design. The pipeline should report mtd_observed_dlt_rate=0.32 vs target 0.25 -> ratio=1.28 -> halt.
